title: Flow Matching Meets 3D Curvilinear Structure Segmentation in Medical Imaging
abstract: arXiv:2608.19965v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Segmentation of curvilinear anatomical structures in 3D medical images remains challenging due to complex topology, severe class imbalance, weak contrast, and large variations in structure morphology. While deep learning approaches for 3D curvilinear segmentation have been proposed, they are often tailored to specific anatomies or modalities, limiting generalization across clinical settings and leaving room for improvement. Recent generative models have shown the benefits of iterative prediction for structured segmentation tasks, yet diffusion-based methods suffer from computationally expensive sampling, hindering their use on high-resolution 3D volumes. We present 3D-CurvSegFlow, a flow matching-based model for 3D curvilinear structure segmentation. translated_title: 流匹配在医学影像三维曲线结构分割中的应用
translated_abstract: 摘要：在三维医学图像中，曲线解剖结构的分割因复杂拓扑、严重类别不平衡、弱对比度以及结构形态的显著变化而仍具挑战性。尽管已提出用于三维曲线分割的深度学习方法，但这些方法通常针对特定解剖结构或模态，限制了跨临床环境的泛化能力，并留有改进空间。近期生成模型展示了迭代预测在结构化分割任务中的优势，但基于扩散的方法因计算昂贵的采样过程而阻碍了其在高分辨率三维体数据中的应用。我们提出了3D-CurvSegFlow，一种基于流匹配的三维曲线结构分割模型。该模型学习从简单源分布到目标血管表示的连续变换，能够逐步细化复杂的曲线几何结构。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于流匹配的三维曲线结构分割模型，通过连续变换实现高效且泛化的曲线解剖结构分割，避免了扩散方法的计算开销。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a flow matching-based model for 3D curvilinear structure segmentation, enabling efficient and generalizable segmentation via continuous transformation while avoiding the computational cost of diffusion methods.
